newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin launches crusade against graft, crime.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin launches crusade against graft, crime.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin, in his state of the nation address to parliament on Thursday, vowed to root out corruption and wage a ruthless fight against crime sweeping Russia.
"I will resolutely punish those who break the constitution and laws," said Yeltsin, 66, speaking in a clear and determined voice. "There is corruption at every level of power."

Yeltsin said the main message of his address was to install order in the country by putting state authorities in order first and that there would be "no untouchables in this drive against corruption and crime."
"The faith of society in the ability of the authorities to stop the wave of crime is undermined."
